goal: Fix remaining design token gaps identified in pre-launch audit

phases.subject: W1: portal/dashboard — full design token migration
phases.description: Replace all hardcoded bg-white, text-gray-*, border-gray-*, font-semibold with design tokens. Token map: bg-white→bg-bg-primary, text-gray-400→text-text-tertiary, text-gray-600→text-text-secondary, text-gray-900→text-text-primary, border-gray-100→border-border-secondary, border-gray-200→border-border-primary, font-semibold→font-bold. Preserve auth logic and GrowthZone API calls.

phases.subject: W2: privacy/page.tsx — Fibonacci spacing sweep
phases.description: Replace default Tailwind spacing: py-16→py-f55, py-24→py-f89, mt-12→mt-f34, mb-4→mb-f13, mt-8→mt-f21, mb-3→mt-f8. Keep px-6 lg:px-8 horizontal padding as-is.

phases.subject: W3: Button adoption + spacing — homepage, workforce, jobs
phases.description: Replace inline-styled Link/a with ButtonLink/ButtonA. Convert default Tailwind spacing to Fibonacci tokens. Homepage hero CTAs: keep white text override since they sit on dark overlay. Replace any font-semibold with font-bold.

phases.subject: W4: Admin components — hardcoded hex → CSS vars
phases.description: Replace #83BCA9→var(--color-cambridge), #0C1B33→var(--color-oxford), ring-[#83BCA9]→focus:ring-cambridge/40, border-gray-*→border-border-*, text-gray-*→design tokens, font-semibold→font-bold.

phases.subject: W5: Verify all fixes, commit, and deploy to Vercel
phases.description: Run tsc --noEmit, verify no bg-white/text-gray-* remain in changed files, check git user.email=singar77@gmail.com, commit with message 'fix: design token sweep — portal dashboard, privacy, button adoption, admin hex', push to main, verify Vercel deployment is READY.
